description: This file defines the 'tree' class which manages hierarchical structures of test-related nodes within the TestLink project, including creation, retrieval, traversal, deletion, and manipulation of test plan and test project nodes.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Represents a hierarchical structure of test components like test projects, test suites, test cases, and requirements, providing methods for managing and traversing the test node tree within the TestLink application.

methods.name: get_available_node_types
methods.description: Retrieves a map of human-readable descriptions to node type IDs from the 'node_types' table, indicating which node types can be used in the hierarchy.

methods.name: new_root_node
methods.description: Creates a new root node in the hierarchy table and returns its ID.

methods.name: new_node
methods.description: Creates a new node in the hierarchy, associating it with a parent node, and returns its ID.

methods.name: get_node_hierarchy_info
methods.description: Fetches hierarchical information for a node given its ID, optionally filtered by parent ID and node type.

methods.name: get_subtree_list
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated list or array of all node IDs in the subtree starting from a specified node.

methods.name: _get_subtree_list
methods.description: Recursively collects node IDs in the subtree starting from a node, used internally.

methods.name: delete_subtree
methods.description: Deletes all nodes in a subtree starting from a specified node ID.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Retrieves the path from the specified node up to the root, with option to reverse order and format output.

methods.name: get_path_new
methods.description: Extended version of get_path that builds a nested structure representing the path.

methods.name: _get_path
methods.description: Internal recursive method to build a path from a node to the root, in various formats.

methods.name: change_parent
methods.description: Changes the parent of one or multiple nodes, effectively moving subtrees.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Returns direct child nodes of a given node, optionally filtering by node type.

methods.name: change_order_bulk
methods.description: Sets the order of multiple nodes based on their position in an array.

methods.name: change_child_order
methods.description: Repositions a child node among its siblings, either to the top or bottom.

methods.name: getBottomOrder
methods.description: Determines the maximum order value among children of a node, to insert new nodes at the bottom.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Retrieves all nodes in a subtree rooted at a specific node, with options to filter and format output.

methods.name: _get_subtree
methods.description: Internal method to recursively retrieve subtree nodes according to specified order and filters.

methods.name: _get_subtree_rec
methods.description: Recursive method to fetch a subtree for 'extjs' format, building a nested structure.

methods.name: get_full_path_verbose
methods.description: Returns a detailed path for a set of nodes, including node names and optionally formatted paths.

methods.name: nodeNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a sibling node of the same type with the same name already exists, useful for validation.

methods.name: getTreeRoot
methods.description: Returns the root node ID of the tree that contains a given node.

methods.name: delete_subtree_objects
methods.description: Deletes objects associated with nodes in a subtree, but does not delete the subtree root.

methods.name: createHierarchyMap
methods.description: Creates a visual hierarchy map (dotted or array) for a list of nodes, indicating their levels.

methods.name: getAllItemsID
methods.description: Recursively collects IDs of all target and container types under given parent nodes.

methods.name: getNodeByAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves nodes matching specific attributes such as type, ID, name, or parent ID.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Gets the node type ID and description for a given node ID.

methods.name: getNameL2
methods.description: Retrieves a concatenated string of node names in a parent-child hierarchy, optionally trimmed.
